name: Ea Kar chicken rice
summary: Rice from Coffee Farm 721 cooked in the water a yard chicken was boiled in, tinted with turmeric, and fried in chicken fat. It comes out rich and crisp outside without cloying.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names cơm gà chiên as the plate people associate with Ea Kar.
howToEat: Eat it with the Ea Kar yard chicken it was cooked with.
seoTitle: Com ga Ea Kar — chicken rice fried in chicken fat
seoDescription: Ea Kar chicken rice, cooked in the chicken liquor, tinted with turmeric, and fried crisp in chicken fat.
